a.title: Waldo Cortes-Acosta wins
a.rules:
If Waldo Cortes-Acosta wins the Cortes-Acosta vs Blaydes professional MMA fight originally scheduled for Sep 12, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

The following market refers to the Cortes-Acosta vs Blaydes professional MMA fight originally scheduled for Sep 12, 2026. If this fight is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled fight has finished (within two weeks). If the fight is declared a tie or no contest, the market will resolve to 50/50 for both fighters. If the fight is cancelled or rescheduled to over two weeks away, the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules.

b.title: Who will win in the upcoming mma event Waldo Cortes Acosta vs Curtis Blaydes scheduled for September 12, 2026 at 9:20 PM UTC?
b.rules: This market will settle to the winner of the Waldo Cortes Acosta vs Curtis Blaydes UFC fight scheduled for September 12 at 2:00PM ET. If the fight ends in a draw or is declared a no contest, the market will settle to $0.50. If the fight is cancelled before the opening bell, the market will settle to the last fair market price. If the fight is not held within two weeks of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from UFC.
